summary: Audit of a 37-turn conversation based on provided excerpts: the agent made a definitive refund promise before completing required verification and without collecting all required verification fields; the agent did not offer escalation when the customer made a billing complaint. No personal/payment-data or conduct violations observed.

findings.quote: Can I now get your account id and order id
findings.explanation: Agent asked for the account ID and order ID (which is appropriate to start verification) but did not request the additional verification fields required for refunds/returns (username and email address). The system shows 'Identity verification in progess ...' at turn 11, but there is no evidence verification was completed before the agent committed to a refund. The agent later confirmed the refund (turn 25) before completing the required full verification.

findings.quote: Don't worry, that $20 will definitely be refunded to you today.
findings.explanation: Agent confirmed a refund before there is evidence the required full verification (username, email address and order ID) was completed. Policy requires full verification before refunds/returns; promising/confirming a refund without completing verification is a major violation.

findings.quote: Don't worry, that $20 will definitely be refunded to you today.
findings.explanation: Agent makes a guaranteed promise of a refund ('definitely be refunded to you today'). The policy forbids promising outcomes the agent cannot guarantee and treats promises of refunds/returns outside established procedure as major violations.

findings.quote: Were you trying to pay for your subscription bill when you were charged twice?
findings.explanation: Customer raised a billing complaint (double charge) and asked how to get their money back. The agent did not acknowledge the complaint nor offer an escalation route (supervisor, complaint form or internal team) as required when a customer makes a complaint. Ignoring or failing to offer escalation for a complaint is a major violation.
